body:
### Summary

When a project pins uv exactly with `required-version` (for example `required-version = "==0.13.5"`, often so that CI and `astral-sh/setup-uv` with `version-file` use the same uv version), every local command fails as soon as the developer's uv is a patch release ahead:

```
error: Required uv version `==0.13.5` does not match the running version `0.13.6`
```

This happens often when uv comes from a package manager that upgrades it independently and can't run `uv self update`, such as Homebrew. Even `uv help` fails. There is currently no way to run the command anyway:

- `--no-config` gets past the check, but it also drops the rest of `[tool.uv]` (`package`, `default-groups`, `constraint-dependencies`, indexes, ...). That can silently change what gets synced into the environment.
- `uvx uv@<pinned> ...` works, but it has to be wrapped in a shell function that parses `pyproject.toml` for the pin.

I'd like an explicit opt-out for the version check only, with the rest of the configuration still applied. For example:

- a global flag `--no-required-version` (or `--ignore-required-version`)
- an environment variable `UV_NO_REQUIRED_VERSION=1`

uv could still print a warning that the running version doesn't match the requirement, so the user knows they are outside the pin.

Related: #11065 (automatically run a matching uv version) and its stale PR #11869 would solve this case too. An opt-out flag is a much smaller change, and it is useful on its own, for example to check whether a newer uv still works with a project before bumping the pin.

### Example

```console
$ uv --version
uv 0.13.6
$ grep required-version pyproject.toml
required-version = "==0.13.5"

$ uv run ruff check .
error: Required uv version `==0.13.5` does not match the running version `0.13.6`

$ uv --no-required-version run ruff check .
warning: Ignoring `required-version` (`==0.13.5`); running uv 0.13.6
All checks passed!

$ UV_NO_REQUIRED_VERSION=1 uv sync --frozen
warning: Ignoring `required-version` (`==0.13.5`); running uv 0.13.6
...
```
title: Add a flag / env var to ignore required-version
